snapshot.title: Triconex SOE Log — ESD-310 Command Mismatch

lines.msg: SIF-650: Control path for ESD-310 changed. Running logic v2.1.7 differs from archived v2.1.6. No MOC on file.
ESD-310 command issued to close. Output not detected. SIF-650 did not trigger.
SIF-650: Safety interlock not activated on ESD-310 closure. Output status: OPEN.
ESD-310: Manual override disabled. Control path now in software-managed state.
SIF-650: Interlock delay timer active. 15-second hold on command execution.
SOE: ESD-310 command received from DeltaV HMI (OWS-01). Origin: 10.72.1.15.
SOE: No operator session logged for ESD-310 command. No user ID in audit trail.
SIF-650: Interlock failure detected. Abnormal state: ESD-310 closed in logic but open in field.
SIF-650: Control path integrity compromised. No MOC on file for v2.1.7.
SIF-650: Controller diagnostics show no hardware fault. All I/O confirmed active.
SIF-650: No external network access logged for TS-EWS-01 between 08:57:00 and 08:59:00.
SOE export initiated by OT Engineer (TVC-OTSEC-2026) via clean laptop (TVC-OTSEC-2026-001).
